card.title: Envious of the Lie
card.instruction: Treat another person’s composure under scrutiny as both impressive and unfair, resenting how easily they seem to control what others believe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You told the manager you hadn't lost the keys and he believed you instantly. How do you do that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I hadn't lost them. I need you to tell him that too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With my face? You get innocence; I get follow-up questions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Could you look impressed when I tell the truth? Yours carries more weight.
